questions.text: Who writes a gate clearance into launch.json?
questions.why: No command a human types advances a run, and a workflow cannot write a file. The record still needs the clearance written by something.

options.value: The human edits launch.json (or later the control surface does); nothing automated writes a gate.
The orchestrator session writes it through a leaf after the human approves in chat.

questions.answer: custom: no gates, only workflows; launch.json was the first builder's idea; workflow agents write, the human checks and tells the orchestrator to run the next workflow
